messages.content: Find me a documentary about global warming.

function.name: retrieve_scientific_paper
function.description: Fetches the details of scientific research paper based on its topic. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

year.description: Year of publishing of the research paper. If not specified, fetches the most recent paper

author.description: Author of the research paper. If not specified, fetches the paper with most citations

message.content:
Here are a few highly regarded documentaries that explore global warming and climate change:

| Title | Year | Synopsis |
|-------|------|----------|
| **An Inconvenient Truth** | 2006 | Former U.S. Vice‑President Al Gore presents scientific evidence on climate change, explaining how rising temperatures affect ecosystems, weather patterns, and human societies. |
| **An Inconvenient Sequel: Truth to Power** | 2017 | A follow‑up to the original film, this sequel examines progress (or lack thereof) since 2006, highlighting new scientific findings and policy developments. |
| **Before the Flood** | 2016 | Leonardo DiCaprio travels around the world to meet scientists, activists, and affected communities, illustrating the human impact of climate change and proposing solutions. |
| **Our Planet** (Netflix series) | 2019 | Narrated by Sir David Attenborough, this visually stunning series shows how climate change threatens wildlife and habitats across the globe, while also showcasing conservation efforts. |
| **Climate Change: The Facts** | 2020 | A concise, fact‑based overview that explains the science behind global warming, its consequences, and mitigation strategies. |

These films are widely available on streaming platforms such as Netflix, Amazon Prime Video, Hulu, or can be rented/bought on iTunes, Google Play, or YouTube Movies. They provide both scientific context and compelling visual storytelling to help viewers understand the urgency of addressing global warming.
